summary: Armed settlers/security-squad members physically detained British activist Finn Joughin and moved him away from Umm al-Kheir before handing him to police
evidence_media: Exact same-event X footage embedded by Times of Israel; no preview published
resolution_notes: Israel Police confirms Joughin was detained by the head of a settlement security squad on suspicion of an indecent act/assault involving a minor; activists and his lawyer characterize the settler detention as kidnapping and deny wrongdoing. Footage independently establishes physical restraint and movement by armed settlers but does not resolve the lawfulness/proportionality of the detention or the underlying allegation. Preserve accusation and denial; do not infer ideological affiliation beyond the documented settler/security-squad role.
